quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #14
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 30

questions.question: When two vehicles arrive at an intersection at the same time with no signs or signals, which one has the right-of-way?

options.text: The vehicle coming from the right.
The vehicle coming from the left.
The vehicle whose driver honks first.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle coming from the right.
questions.explanation: At an intersection without traffic control signs, you must yield to a vehicle coming from your right.

questions.question: You must not drive faster than:

options.text: A speed that is safe and reasonable.
A speed that is safe for current conditions.

questions.explanation: You must obey speed limits and drive at a speed that is safe for traffic, weather, road conditions, pedestrians, and visibility. Never drive faster than is safe and reasonable for the situation.

questions.question: To help prevent crashes, you should:

options.text: Ignore other drivers on the road.
Drive only on side streets and back roads.

questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers do unexpected things. Tell other drivers, cyclists, and pedestrians what you plan to do. Use your turn signals, brake lights, emergency signals, and horn when needed.

questions.question: At a light rail crossing, you should always:

options.text: Look both ways before crossing the tracks.
Pay attention and obey all traffic signals.
Share the road with pedestrians and cyclists.

questions.explanation: Never drive around lowered crossing gates. Look both ways before crossing train tracks. Always obey signs and signals. Trains share the road with cars and bicycles.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down when you approach railroad tracks. Trains cannot stop for you, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is coming. Enter at low speed and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: If traffic signals are not working due to a power outage:

options.text: Park your vehicle off the road and wait for power to return.
Use hand signals to show other drivers what you will do.
Turn on hazard lights and go through the intersection without stopping.
Treat it as a four-way stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it as a four-way stop.
questions.explanation: When a traffic light is not working, treat the intersection like a four-way stop. Yield to other drivers as you would at a stop sign. When it is your turn, go through carefully.

questions.question: To safely pass a bicycle, you should:

options.text: Honk to let them know you are passing.
Drive in the bike lane to get around them.
Slow down and give as much space as possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and give as much space as possible.
questions.explanation: When passing a bicycle, slow down and give lots of space. Bicyclists have little protection and can be knocked off balance if you pass too close or too fast.

questions.question: When driving on ice or snow, what helps prevent crashes?

options.text: Add extra weight to your vehicle for better grip.
Leave the highway as quickly as possible.
Drive slower and increase your distance from other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive slower and increase your distance from other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Slow down on snow and ice. Increase your following distance. These are the best ways to avoid crashes in winter conditions.

questions.question: An oncoming driver does not dim their high beams. Where should you look?

options.text: At the wheels of the other vehicle.
Toward the right side of the road.
Toward the left side of the road.
Straight ahead down the middle of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: Look to the right side of the road to avoid being blinded by bright headlights. This lets you see the road and stay in your lane until the other vehicle passes.

questions.question: Trucks, tractor-trailers, buses, and RVs have:

options.text: Much smaller blind spots than smaller cars.
Much larger blind spots than smaller cars.
Blind spots the same size as cars' blind spots.

questions.correctAnswerText: Much larger blind spots than smaller cars.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles have much larger blind spots than cars.

questions.question: A good rule for passing is:

options.text: Pass on the right whenever possible.
Drive with the flow of traffic and pass only when needed.
Try to get to the front of slow-moving traffic so you can see better.
Always flash your lights and sound your horn to alert other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with the flow of traffic and pass only when needed.
questions.explanation: Each pass creates a chance for a collision. If you drive faster than others, you will need to keep passing. Drive with traffic flow at the legal speed limit and pass only when needed.

questions.question: At dusk or on overcast days, you should:

options.text: Not turn on any vehicle lights.

questions.explanation: Turn on your headlights at dusk or in overcast conditions. Use low beams when within 1,000 feet of an oncoming vehicle or within 500 feet of a vehicle ahead. Always use low beams in poor weather.

questions.question: This sign is a:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow with black letters or symbols. They warn drivers about hazards ahead.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to roadwork.
Slow down because the road ahead curves sharply.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead curves sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves sharply. Slow down before the curve just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: When it starts to rain while driving, you should:

options.text: Drive at the maximum posted speed limit.
Drive closely behind the vehicle in front of you.

questions.explanation: When rain reduces visibility, slow down. Turn on your headlights so others can see you. If rain is too heavy to see clearly, pull to the shoulder and stop until it improves.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns of a sharp turn ahead and means you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: The safest place to install a child safety seat is in:

options.text: The center of the back seat.
Any passenger seat; they are equally safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: The center of the back seat.
questions.explanation: The safest place for a child safety seat is in the center of the back seat.

questions.question: If you feel tired while driving, the best thing to do is:
questions.explanation: Driving while tired is as dangerous as driving under the influence. Stop driving if you feel tired.

questions.question: You can avoid alcohol-related crashes by:

options.text: Deciding before you drink that you will not drive.
Saying "No thanks, I'm driving" if someone offers you a drink.

questions.explanation: The only way to prevent drunk driving is to decide not to drive before you start drinking. Alcohol affects your judgment, making it harder to make safe choices after you have been drinking.

questions.question: You are driving up a hill and see a heavy truck ahead of you. What should you know?

options.text: The truck may be going slower than the speed limit.
You may not be able to safely pass the truck.
You may not be able to legally pass the truck.

questions.explanation: Large trucks often go slower than the speed limit, especially on hills. You should be careful when approaching them from behind. On a hill with poor visibility, it is illegal to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers to keep right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: When preparing to turn left, drivers should:

options.text: Slow down gradually while checking the rearview mirror.
Watch for oncoming vehicles and pedestrians.

questions.explanation: Before turning left, signal three to five seconds ahead. Check your rearview mirror and slow down gradually. Move into the left lane before the intersection. Yield to traffic and pedestrians. Turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: A court can suspend or revoke your license if you are convicted of:
questions.explanation: A court can suspend or revoke your license if you are convicted of reckless or aggressive driving, driving without a valid license, driving with a suspended license, refusing a breath or blood test for a DUI, or failing to pay for gas.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are driving the wrong way. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: As alcohol builds up in your blood, it:

options.text: Breaks down faster in your body.
Reduces the number of driving errors.

questions.explanation: As alcohol builds up in your system, it slows your reactions, makes you feel more confident, and causes you to make more mistakes.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching.
Come to a complete stop and go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign requires you to come to a full stop. Yield to vehicles and pedestrians in or approaching the intersection. Proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: When driving at night, using only your parking lights is unlawful.
questions.explanation: You cannot drive at night using only parking lights. You must use your headlights when driving in the dark.

questions.question: Turning your head to check your blind spot before changing lanes, leaving a curb, or merging into traffic is:

options.text: Not necessary if you use the rearview mirror.

questions.explanation: Always check your blind spots by looking over your shoulder before changing lanes. Do not rely only on your mirrors.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: Which statement about emergency vehicles is true?

options.text: They have the right-of-way when using sirens, horns, and/or flashing lights.
They may use a loudspeaker to give instructions.

questions.explanation: You must yield to police cars, fire engines, ambulances, and other emergency vehicles using a siren or air horn and red or blue flashing lights. Follow instructions from their loudspeakers. Emergency vehicles often follow each other, so only proceed when you are sure the road is clear.

questions.question: A driver is turning and a pedestrian is crossing without a traffic light. Who must yield?
questions.explanation: Drivers must yield to pedestrians crossing at any intersection without a traffic light, whether or not there is a marked crosswalk.

questions.question: When must you always signal?

options.text: When pulling into or out of a parking space.
When pulling into traffic from a parking area or alley.

questions.explanation: Always use your turn signals when moving left or right. Signal when pulling into traffic from a parking space, changing lanes, or passing another vehicle.

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle if the line between your lane and the lane you want to enter is a ____ line.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. You may cross broken white lines to pass when it is safe.
